Simplification of extradition laws
*41. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
SHRI SUKHDEV SINGH
LIBRA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the efforts Government have made
with other countries to simplify
extradition laws; and
(b) the progress made in this regard,
so for?
Tenth Five Year Plan
†*42. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that after the
recent discussions on the Tenth Five Year
Plan representatives of several State
Governments have expressed their
inability to achieve the targets set for plan
period;
(b) if so, the names of such States;
(c) the reasons for expressing their
inability to achieve the targets; and
(d) whether it is also a fact that due to
the inability of the State Governments it
would be impossible to achieve the targets
set to remove unemployment and to
eliminate poverty?
Buffer stock of sugar
*43. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that differences
are getting sharper between sugar mills
in the co-operative and private sectors over
modalities for allocation of the recently
announced buffer stock of 20 lakh tonne;
(b) if so, what are the main
differences;
(c) whether Government have consi-
dered views of all the sugar mills; and
(d) if so, to what extent Government

14

have compromised and satisfied the sugar
mills for issue of buffer  stock allocation?
Electronic telephone exchanges
in H.P.
*44. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the electronic tele-
phone exchanges set up in Himachal
Pradesh during the last three years,
district-wise;
(b) the details of the funds earmarked/
disbursed/utilised, so far, for the said
purpose during this period; and
(c) the details of the plan formulated
for setting up of more electronic tele-
phone exchanges in the State during the
Tenth Five Year Plan period?
Disinvestment of National Fertilizers
Limited
*45. SHRI C.O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that overall
performance of the National Fertilizers
Limited (NFL) is very impressive and its
net profit after tax deduction during the
last fiscal year has been registered at
Rs. 40.61 crores against Rs. 27.31 crores
in 2000-2001;
(b) if so, Government's response
thereto alongwith the reasons for the
decision to divest 51 per cent of its equity;
(c) whether Government have any plan
to review the decision of disinvestment
of NFL; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Transport corridor to Afghanistan
through Iran
*46. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA RAO:
SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state what has
been the action taken to develop a
transport corridor from India to
Afghanistan and Central Asia through Iran
in view of Pakistan denying facilities for
overland trade between India and
Afghanistan?
Invitation to NRIs for Pravasi
Bharatiya Diwas
*47. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of NRIs who were
issued invitation by Government for first
meeting of "PRAVASI BHARATIYA
DIWAS'' held on the 9th January, 2003 in
New Delhi;
(b) the number of NRIs who actually
attended the meeting;
(c) whether such meeting of the NRIs
would be called every year in future;
(d) whether a permanent Organisa-
tion of NRIs has been set up in Delhi under
the auspices of Government; and
(e) if so, the details in this regard?
Self-sufficiency in launching heavier
satellites
*48. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM MANHAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:

(c) whether it is also a fact that the
National Science Congress is being held
in Bangalore and Government have
already outlined the steps to be taken for
moving towards commercialization of the
space operations; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

Sending abroad of CBI personnel
†182. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER  be
pleased  to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several CBI
personnel were sent abroad to extradite the
criminals wanted by India during the last
three years; and
(b) the number of criminals extradited to
India during the above said period?
ARIs in Rajasthan
183. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) what is the present status of Agro
and Rural Industries in Rajasthan;
(b) whether there are any potentials for
developing new Agro and Rural Industries
in the State;
(c) if so, the new schemes Government
propose to introduce in the State; and
(d) the impact of introducing new cash
crops in the State of Rajasthan?
ARIs in Kashmir Valley
184. PROF. SAIF-UD-DIN SOZ: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that no industry
has been set up in Kashmir Valley during
the last four years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government would set up
Agro and Rural Industries in the Valley?
Employment generation by
KVIC in NER
185. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a)whether the Khadi and Village
Industries Commission (KVIC) has decided
to generate new employment opportunities
in the North Eastern Region during the Tenth
Plan period;

(c) whether Department for
Development of North Eastern Region

higher allocation for the rural employment

(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Setting up of nuclear power plants
186. DR. AKHILESH DAS:
SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plan to set up
a number of Nuclear Power Plants in
different parts of the country, including one
in Mandla District of Madhya Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details of the Plants to be
set up, indicating their locations, power
genration capacity and the time schedule
therefor; and
(c) the progress made on each project
and the expected time of their completion?
Links between cell operators and
BSNL/MTNL
187. SHRI GHULAM NABI
AZAD: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether public sector telecom
players BSNL and MTNL have snapped
their links with cell operators; and
(b) if so, the reasons the refor?
Difference between basic and mobile
telephone tariff
†188. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state the difference in basic
as well as mobile telephone tariff being
charged in the country and how does it
compare with some selected countries?
Mobile facility in N.E. Region
189. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA :
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMAT ION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the places in the North Eastern
Region where mobile facility has already
been provided in the first phase and
proposed for the second and third phases;
(b) whether operation of the ban
imposed on mobile telephone in most parts
of the North Eastern Region has been lifted;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) by when this facility would be made
operational in the remaining parts of the
North Eastern Region?
Waiting List for telephone
connections

SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons on the waiting
list for telephone connections in the country
as on the 30th April, 2002, district-wise/
State-wise;
(b) the number of telephone connections
provided during the last three years, till date,
district-wise; and
